book.title: MUSELU WAPAMA WA YESU woolebiwa ni Luka

content: Yoothega, Nroromelo, Oleveleliwa ni Yowiirana
Yesu ahawiirelaga anamasuuza aaye: “Kadhinandeya wi dhoholosa dhihidhe, mbwenye oddilu wa muthu oyene onadhana.
Yaali yoofwanelela amageleliwe mukohi nibwe na nsilo, avokedhiwe munyaza, ohiya omukwakwathusa muthu mmohi mwa athu ohuthithimiheya ala.
Pole-pole. “Akala ddibilawo ohuthega, omusumulule; atthwaruwa, omulevelele.
Oothegela we dila tanu nabiili vanlaboni, dila tanu nabiili adha wa we, eeraga: ‘Gihitthwaruwa,’ omulevelele.”
Vano, arumiwi yahimwiirelaga Nabwiya: “Munenjedhedhe nroromelo neehu!”
Nabwiya ahawaakulaga, wiira: “Mwakalana nroromelo woona bewu ya mukwani muneerege wiirela muthanko wa amora ola: ‘Wiiddule, weedhale munyaza,’ vano, oneerege wuwiiwelelani.
“Baani wa nyoovo, onakanna mwiimeleli aaye alabaga omudda, naari ang'anelaga mabila, voweruwa omudda amwiirela: ‘Odhe mowaaguva okaraati, oje’?
Kuneere nda, onomwaaddela: ‘Osasanyedhe yooja, oware guwo dhimohi, ogiimelele. Vano miyo gamala oja ni ong'wa, we fineeriwe oje, ong'we’?
Munoobuwelela wi oneere omutamalela mwiimeleli ola, mwaha wi ohiirana dharumiwiye?
Ndala teto nyo, mweerana dhaaddeliwinyu, mwiire: ‘Nili eemeleli ebeweene mwaha wi nihiirana dhafwaneelihu wiira.’”
Oyilihiwa wa Aliba Maredda Kumi
Yesu adhowaga oZheruzalemi, ahivira mmiganoni mwa Samariya ni Galileya.
Avolowagawene mmudhini, athu kumi a maredda yahimuharelaga, wiimela wuddeddewene.
Egeemelile wuddedde wewule yookuwaga, yiiraga: “Yesu, Namasuuziha, muneeddiwele thagaraga!”
Yesu agawoonile, ahiiraga: “Mudhowe mweyoonihe wa anamakutha.” Dhahipadduwa edhowaga mundila yahiyilihiwaga.
Mmohi wa kumi ale, agoonile wi gihiyilihiwa, ahiwelelaga mundduli amutamalaga Mulugu ni ndhu notaama.
Agafiyile vaaligi Yesu, ahikokoraga oworomihedha kove vati va manyalo a Yesu, atamalelaga. Ola aali muSamariya.
Vano, Yesu ahimukohaga: “Kamwaali kumi mweelihiwe? Ki atanu ni anayi eli waani?
Kalivo mmohi owelile wi amuthithimihe Mulugu, ahili mwanaweedda ola?”
Omwiirela: “Venya, odhowege nroromelo naawo nuhuyiliha.
Odha wa Omwene wa Mulugu
Dhahipadduwa ayi, maFarizi yahimukohaga Yesu wi Omwene wa Mulugu onadha alini? Yesu ahawaakulaga, wiira: “Omwene wa Mulugu kunadha ni mukalelo wowooneya ni meento,
athu kidha ewogaga: ‘Oli veva,’ naari ‘Ole oli vale,’ vowi Omwene wa Mulugu oli muwaari mwa nyo.”
Yesu ahawaaddela anamasuuza aaye, wiira: “Onofiya mudhidhi onafuniginyu woona nlabo nimohi na Mwaana a Muthu; mwa malabo alene, kamudha moona.
Athu enodha yuwaaddelegeni: ‘Oli va!’ naari ‘Oli wule!’ Kamuyewo naari kamwahare.
Vowi nlabo nnadha Mwaana a Muthu kanidha naanganyedheya onakale woona ozherima, onadheela odhulu omooneyelaga dhipaddi dhatedhene.
Mbwenye enofuneya wi vowambeela oliye arabulihiwe mwa dhego dhijinji, akooddiwe ni mulogo ola.
“Dhapadduwile malabo a Nowe, teto sinapadduwe malabo a Mwaana a Muthu.
Yooja, yoong'wa, alobwana yootela, ahiyana yooteliwa, ofiyedha nlabo navolowile Nowe mmwanddeyani. Vano odha mutokora waatolosa ateene.
“Dhimohive dhedhi dhahipadduwa malabo a Lothi. Yooja, yoong'wa, yoogula, yooguliha, yoodhala, yoomaga nyuba dhijinji.
Nlabo nendde Lothi navenyigiye oSoddoma, odhulu wahirubwaga munddo, ni mabwe oohidda, waatolosa ateene.
“Dhinadha dhiireye ndala nlabo noodha wiyooneyiha Mwaana a Muthu.
Nlabo nddo, onaakale odhulu wa nyuba, onadhe akite wi akumihemo dhookalana dhaaye dhili mba. Emodha-modhave onakale omudda, ahiwelele mundduli wi athukule yego.
Mubuwelele dha mwadha Lothi!
Ole onafuna wing'anela egumi yaaye, onoyelela, vano ole onayelele onovulumusa.
Ginowuwaaddelani: Mahiyu ayene abiili enodha ekale vakamani; onodha athukuliwevo mmohi, ahiyiwevo mmohiwa.
Ahiyana abiili enodha etidege vamohi, athukuliwevo mmohi, ahiyiwevo mmohiwa.”
Vano, anamasuuza aaye yahimukohaga: “Dhineereye waani dhedhi, Nabwiyani?” Yesu ahaakulaga, wiira: “Vevo vinaakale muruthu, fivevo teto vinatugumane mibidha.

footnotes.text: Dhoolebowa ni madada dhijinji kanna verisikulu 36

Madhu ala enatapulea wi odha wa Mwaana a Muthu kudha orabuleleya. Athu ateene enodha enone, avakuukuvi ni awoolapela enodha etugumanege odha ogumana ni Oliye. Moone Mt 24:28; Ap 19: 21, 17:32; Gen 19:26.
